backend/main.mo: Main actor defining booking system with CRUD operations for cleaning service bookings (create, get, getAll, getByCustomer) and legacy contact form types for migration compatibility.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms old ContactForm-based actor state to new Booking-based state, initializing empty bookings map and resetting booking ID counter.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: booking system component, service area display, and booking navigation with high confidence and associated test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing components for navigation, services, booking form, contact form, and styling for Nikole Maligranda cleaning business.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme variables for background, foreground, primary, secondary, accent, and component colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with page title 'Nikole Maligranda Attention to Detail' and root div for React application mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component orchestrating layout with navigation, hero, service area, four service sections, booking form, contact form, and footer with smooth scrolling navigation.
frontend/src/components/BookingForm.tsx: Booking form component with customer details, service type selection, date/time pickers, and address fields that submits to backend actor and displays confirmation with booking ID.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: A React form component for general inquiries with fields for name, email, phone, service type, and message. Includes form validation, submission state management, and success/error alerts, though the actual backend submission is commented out.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Landing page hero section component displaying the business name, tagline, background image with overlay, and call-to-action buttons that scroll to contact and services sections.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Sticky header navigation component with responsive design, featuring desktop menu and mobile sheet drawer, smooth scrolling to page sections, and a logo with business name.
frontend/src/components/ServiceArea.tsx: Component displaying the geographic service coverage (Llano County and Burnet County) with cards showing each county and a description of local service commitment.
frontend/src/components/ServiceGrid.tsx: Grid layout component displaying four main service categories (Residential, Commercial, Car Detailing, Carpet Cleaning) as clickable cards with icons that scroll to detailed sections.
frontend/src/components/services/CarDeta: Detailed car detailing service section showing three pricing tiers (Basic, Premium, Deluxe) with feature lists and pricing starting from $99 to $299.
frontend/src/components/services/CarpetC: Carpet cleaning service section displaying three cleaning methods (Steam, Dry, Hot Water Extraction) and a list of eight benefits of professional carpet cleaning.
frontend/src/components/services/Commerc: React component displaying commercial cleaning services with a feature list (schedules, sanitization, floor care, etc.) and industries served (offices, retail, medical, educational) using Card UI and Lucide icons.
frontend/src/components/services/Residen: React component showcasing residential cleaning services with features (deep cleaning, kitchen/bathroom sanitization, eco-friendly products) and benefits (time savings, healthier environment) using Card UI and Check icons.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and manages an ICP backend actor using Internet Identity authentication, automatically invalidating and refetching dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Custom React Query hooks for booking operations including fetching all bookings, single booking by ID, bookings by customer, and creating new bookings with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a fresh green and warm orange color palette for light/dark modes, optimized for a cleaning company brand.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, rendering the main App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, Inter font family, container settings, custom shadows, and accordion animations with typography and container query plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking implemented features for a cleaning company website (Nikole Maligranda Attention to Detail) serving Llano and Burnet counties, with services including residential, commercial, car detailing, and carpet cleaning.
